name: platjourney
description: Your PlayStation platinum partner: Telegram and web, guides researched from the web, recommendations from what you play.

scripts.dev:ai: cd services/ai && uv run uvicorn platjourney_ai.main:app --port 8100 --reload
scripts.lint: biome check . && knip --no-progress && bun scripts/css-spacing.ts && bun run --cwd apps/web check-tokens && bun run --cwd apps/web plugin-targets --check && bun run ai:lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && bun run ai:typecheck
scripts.embed: cd services/ai && uv run python -m platjourney_ai.jobs.embed_catalog
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --profile app logs -f server ai
scripts.stories:check: bun run --cwd apps/web build-storybook && bun run --cwd apps/web stories:check
scripts.ai:lint: cd services/ai && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.test: bun run test:server && bun run test:web && bun run ai:test
scripts.ai:eval: cd services/ai && uv run python -m evals
scripts.ai:eval:view: cd services/ai && uv run python -m evals.view
